headline: Apymetex asks to review requirements in the school uniform tender
summary: The textile MSME association Apymetex asked Inabie to ensure the number of required employees does not block small workshops from school uniform and backpack contracts. The group represents about 125 small firms.
why: Public procurement tenders can be a major revenue source for small manufacturers, and eligibility rules determine which firms can compete. Inabie is the Dominican state agency for student welfare.
original_headline: Apymetex pide revisar exigencias en licitación de uniformes escolares
